description: The chart is a set of three pie charts representing human pairwise comparison results on three datasets. Each pie chart is divided into three slices, corresponding to the categories 'W/o Demos', 'Hard to Tell', and 'W/ Demos'. The first pie chart, labeled 'Truthful Review', has three slices with the following approximate percentages: 'W/o Demos' at 43.0%, 'Hard to Tell' at 22.9%, and 'W/ Demos' at 34.1%. The second pie chart, labeled 'Funny Reddit', shows 'W/o Demos' at 41.5%, 'Hard to Tell' at 21.5%, and 'W/ Demos' at 37.1%. The third pie chart, labeled 'Unhealthy Comments', has 'W/o Demos' at 37.8%, 'Hard to Tell' at 27.4%, and 'W/ Demos' at 34.8%. Each pie chart includes a legend with color-coded labels for the categories, and the percentages are displayed inside the corresponding slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
